configuration.vrmse_formula: Standard VRMSE = mean(compute_vrmse(pred, target)) across all evaluated windows (evaluated across all 4 physical channels: u, v, p, s)
configuration.vrmse_diagnostic_rms_formula: Custom diagnostic RMS of window VRMSE = sqrt(mean(compute_vrmse(pred, target)^2)) across windows
configuration.spread_formula: Pooled RMS spread = sqrt(mean(var_k)) with Bessel correction (ddof=1)
